source_anchors.Cheeger_Tian_status: Original JAMS PDF download failed (AMS 403; several public guesses 404/SSL). Exact theorem statement read from Ge-Jiang 2017 source lines 29-36, not the original paper.
source_anchors.Cheeger_Tian_secondary_statement: There exist universal epsilon,C: if (M,g,p) is Einstein 4D, Ric=lambda g, |lambda|<=3, and int_{B_r(p)} |Rm|^2 <= epsilon for r<=1, then sup_{B_{r/2}} |Rm| <= C r^{-2}, with no volume assumption.

minimal_mixed_patterns.operator_norm_consequence: Because each active block has a 2D kernel and zeta is chosen in it, all first obstruction coefficients lambda_i vanish at every node. cheeger_tian_vs_c0_ricci.regularity_conclusion: This fixed-manifold sequence has ||Ric-g||_op -> 0 and local L2 curvature -> 0 but |Rm|(center)->infinity; it falsifies a Cheeger-Tian-style pointwise epsilon regularity theorem under C0 Ricci pinching, while not affecting the exact Einstein theorem.

chern_weil_chiral_pinning.near_einstein_collapse: If ||Ric-sigma g||_op -> 0 and Vol -> 0, then the integral term tends to 0; both chiral energies are topologically pinned with no slack.

route_consequences.mixed_wall_conditional_repaired: For the purpose of producing Yau-26 input metrics, Biquard Section 4 Lemma 4.2 is enough: once the first vector obstruction is killed at every selected A1 node, the complete unprojected Ricci defect of the glued approximate metric is small in g_t operator norm. The earlier phrase 'Biquard Section 14' was wrong for this estimate; Section 14 is transversality in the arXiv version.
route_consequences.conditionality_remaining: The estimate directly covers the local/refined approximate metric. It does not prove that the smooth mixed fillings have no far-away Einstein metric, and it does not provide H4-dual necessity for arbitrary C0-Ricci-pinched degenerations.
route_consequences.positive_collapse_reframing: Do not test almost-Killing production on symmetric exact Killing examples. The useful task is adversarial: try to globalize twist-spike/local-jet mechanisms into closed collapsing near-pinched families, or identify the obstruction that prevents this.
route_consequences.regularity_ceiling: Cheeger-Tian is the right Einstein collapse-tolerant epsilon regularity theorem, but Step 11 structurally falsifies its C0-Ricci-pinched pointwise analogue: the missing term is uncontrolled second derivatives of Ricci/metric in the trace-free Hessian channel.
route_consequences.energy_defect_target: Since Chern-Weil pins both chiral Weyl energies in collapsed tight pinching, counting cannot refute toric/rod collapse. A positive-collapse obstruction must prove forced loss/defect of energy to lower-dimensional limits, transition regions, or nonmaximal nilpotent topology.
